column1: # The codebase-memory-mcp (CBM) release that Concordia is tested with.
# Read by the concordia binary (embedded: `concordia cbm install` and `doctor`) and by the mise task tools:cbm.
# Linux uses the fully static "-portable" build, as the upstream installer does.
# Rows: "version <tag>", "repository <owner/name>", then one row per platform (fields are separated by tabs):
# A digest is 64 lower-case hex digits, without a "sha256:" prefix. A malformed file fails `go test ./internal/cbmpin`.
